desc:
🍏 Welcome to Sakadung Tower Defence!

The apples are attacking! Build your team, place your towers, and stop the waves before they reach your base!

🎲 SUMMON units and collect Legendary towers!
⚔️ UPGRADE your defenders and combine their abilities!
🤝 TRADE with other players to complete your collection!
👥 TEAM UP with friends and take on tougher challenges!

🗺️ Choose your challenge:
🏙️ Apple City — Easy
🏜️ Desert — Hard
📡 Signal HQ — Extreme

Smart placement and the right upgrades can make all the difference. Can your team survive the final wave?

⭐ Favorite the game and leave a like if you enjoy playing!
